text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The glass walls and the visible conference room suggest a space devoted to collaboration and the generation of new ideas. As I move further in and see the 'R+D' display, my philosophical mind is ignited by the invitation to contemplate the interaction between humanity and technology. There is a vibrant energy and an undercurrent of thoughtful exploration, as if every object and design here challenges me to reflect on the evolving nature of knowledge and connection.
